reviews.text: I'm taking my dog ​​there for the first time. A neighbor recommended the vet, and I've only heard good things about it.
Very attentive and professional in their service and attention
Excellent service and super professional
Excellent service, they treat the animals with love.
Excellent service. Excellent veterinarians, very accurate, very kind. They explain things very well. And it's not expensive.
Affordable prices and amazing service, both for the dogs and for us. Highly recommended, but be aware that it gets quite busy.
Excellent service!
Excellent service and trustworthiness

In my experience, we have Pomeranians and we're very happy with their grooming and bathing services. Communication is key, and whenever we ask for extra details about Dorcas's grooming, they always provide excellent service.
The veterinarian was very attentive.

I went for a vaccine, a 5-minute procedure. I kept waiting even after they gave my place in line; they gave it to someone who arrived after me. They acknowledged the mistake and told me they'd see me shortly, but that never happened. I left after waiting for two hours because it looked like I wouldn't be seen anytime soon, and they were about to close. The doctors are very kind and highly trained, but the organization is terrible. Every time I went, the wait was long, and I always heard the same comments from other patients: if you go to this vet clinic, make sure you have plenty of time. I won't be going back.

The best. My Wicho comes in happy and comes out even happier because of the care he receives. Thanks to Dr. Rubí for taking such good care of my little guy.
Receptionist, doctors, staff, female doctors, specialists—they all deserve a 10. Even the friendly cat is a great host!

I think the hospital is very well-equipped; it just needs to be open 24 hours. My dog ​​is currently undergoing treatment there and is responding well. They did an ultrasound there, and they have lab tests. I'll update my review after the treatment.

Attentive and trained staff dedicated to providing the best care and health for your furry friends. The best veterinarians.
The bathing and grooming service is excellent. Appointments are required and must be scheduled by phone.

Dr. Ana is a very kind person, and it's clear she loves what she does. She always treats pets with respect and affection, which inspires a lot of trust. The care is excellent, the place is clean, and they genuinely care about the well-being of each animal. They are very attentive and careful at all times. I highly recommend them.
Friendly and specialized service
The doctors provide excellent care and treat the pets well. Unfortunately, the wait time is long due to high demand. Prices are reasonable (lower compared to the vet in Cancun where I take my dog).
Very good, but it's a lot of work and you need at least 25 minutes for them to attend to your pet; I've waited an hour, but it's worth it.
Wide variety of products and services, very good customer service.
For the past 5 years, this has been the place where, in addition to making my dogs look "handsome," they get vaccinated and their health is monitored 🤩 …
Well-trained female doctors, precise interventions.

The best vet!
They treat you incredibly well, they're wonderful with the pets, very responsible and professional.
I don't mind driving 40 minutes or more, because I know it's worth it 🫶🏾
Dr. Ana is a sweetheart, the best place for your furry friend. My kittens are super cared for, attended to, and followed up with. I honestly can't give it 7 stars.

In my experience, these surgeries were performed by doctors with absolutely no ethics or professionalism. We entrusted our pet's life to them, and they practically handed her back to us dying after a botched surgery. They didn't even tell us the surgery hadn't gone well; they were in such a hurry for us to pick her up, as if they were afraid she would die on the premises. If you want your pet to be healthy and heal, this is not a place I would recommend.
The worst place to entrust your pet's life.
I hope my terrible experience with this place serves some purpose and protects other pets from the terrible pain they put us through. My pet was in excruciating pain for over 12 hours. Today, our pet, a part of our family, is gone, and it was all because of their dishonesty, inexperience, and complete lack of ethics.
Excellent care from all the veterinarians, very patient and loving, my dog ​​loves them.
